name: Schwerte (Germany)
description: White hoist charged with the city arms of Schwerte (two crossed swords on red), the fly divided horizontally red over white.
history: The arms were granted together with the seal and the banner on 18 February 1977 by the Regierungspräsident in Arnsberg; the crossed swords already appear in a fresco of arms in St Viktor's church from the end of the 15th century.

features.role: white hoist, the fly divided red over white
